checks.detail: Programmatic source comparison confirms V2 equals V1 with exactly the single `--all` argument addition.
The existing empty ControlGroup handling now receives the property; empty leaves own_cgroup null and no host-root cgroup fallback is introduced.
V2 retains the exact ROOT_LAUNCH return-code and InvocationID checks, explicit exited/success/zero exit checks, and expected CPU/memory/swap/runtime checks before returning a capture.
V2 retains the prior success-only guard that aborts if FAILURE.json exists. Do not use it to capture failed runs.

Stop helper remains unchanged and exact-unit gated. Root must first durably capture and locally validate raw receipt lengths/SHA and producer schemas, then call stop only for this exact exited invocation.

launch_binding.terminal_observation: Root reports exact invocation terminal success with status 0 before this review; this review does not independently query the remote host.

limitations: Capture helper is success-path-only; it asserts FAILURE.json is absent.
The helper checks the 4,000,000-byte limit after read_bytes(), bounding transported data but not pre-read allocation.
This review is not scientific-result acceptance and does not replace root-side raw-byte integrity/schema verification.
scope: Independent static review of the corrected read-only terminal capture helper and unchanged exact-stop helper. No remote action, rerun, or compute action was performed for this review.

v1_failure.effect: The capture exited before printing a receipt. It had already performed read-only unit/parent property queries and parent-cgroup snapshot; it did not reach the receipt file-payload encoding loop or any stop command. No compute, model/array reads, source edits, or job restart occurred in this failure path.
v1_failure.observed_error: KeyError: 'ControlGroup' at receipt construction because ordinary `systemctl show` omitted the empty terminal-unit property.

v2_diff.compute_impact: The sole difference is a read-only systemd property-query flag. It does not change or rerun the admitted compute. V1 produced no payload receipt, so V2 must perform the intended metadata-only capture once; root must validate its raw bytes locally before exact stop.
v2_diff.control_group_effect: systemctl show --all includes empty properties, allowing the existing ControlGroup == empty check to set own_cgroup_empty_terminal=true and leave own_cgroup null. The code does not fall back to /sys/fs/cgroup root.
v2_diff.only_change: The properties() command changes from systemctl --user show UNIT to systemctl --user show --all UNIT.
v2_diff.other_capture_and_stop_logic: Unchanged from V1; exact launch return code, InvocationID, terminal success, exit status, configured caps/runtime, metadata-only file allowlist, parent cgroup scoping, success-only FAILURE absence check, and stop helper gates remain intact.
